receiptRule: Lane receipts are exact-SHA evidence caches and never outrank a newer live branch head.
mutationRule: Change only the smallest owning shard. Do not expand this manifest back into a monolithic mutable state payload.

legacySnapshot.note: Historical full state remains in Git history; do not copy it into routine writes.

retiredRuntimePolicy: Maze/PipsQuest, StarBlox/Brookhaven, RHS-exact/licensed-exact, game/**, old feat/*, retired Maze/Pips worktrees/branches, and Roblox places titled StarBlox are historical only.
automationImmutability: No worker may mutate any Roblox task definition, schedule, or enablement without explicit user instruction.
